name: git_changelog
description: Analyze git commit history, parse Conventional Commits (feat, fix, perf, docs, chore), calculate recommended SemVer version bump (major, minor, patch), and generate clean release notes and changelog entries.

repo_path.description: Path to the git repository. Defaults to current directory ('.').

from_ref.description: Starting git commit/tag. Defaults to the latest tag (or initial commit if no tags exist).

current_version.description: Current SemVer version (e.g. '0.1.0' or 'v1.2.3'). If omitted, attempts to extract from the latest git tag.

format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (formatted changelog section) or 'json' (structured categorizations and bump data).

include_hashes.description: Include short commit hashes in the changelog. Default true.
